verdict.rationale: The agency's own business-license page publishes processing-time estimates by submission channel: about 10 business days for online applications and up to six weeks for mailed ones. These read as static guidance rather than live, current processing times, and they cover only license applications. missing for 10: evidence that the times are current or regularly updated (dated or live figures), processing times for other transaction types (refunds, amended returns, binding rulings, account changes), and independent corroboration of actual turnaround.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: Apply online applications will take approximately 10 business days to process.
Mailed applications can take up to six weeks to process.
